name: Vecbase
tagline: A shared workspace where AI agents with roles like Researcher, Coder, and Writer work as a team
verdict: Vecbase packages multi-agent collaboration, shared memory and files, built-in AI capabilities, and one-click integrations into a single subscription, which is appealing for teams tired of stitching together separate tools. The tradeoffs are a hard cap of 10 agents per workspace, usage-based overage billing on top of the base plan, no free trial, and documentation that leans heavily on Chinese, all worth weighing before committing.
